verdict.rationale: Rippling's own IAM page says its federated identity handles OIDC and custom SAML apps, which covers the core of SSO for apps outside the catalog. This rests on a single marketing line, with no setup docs or independent confirmation. Missing for 10: header-based app SSO support, documented step-by-step walkthroughs for configuring custom SAML/OIDC apps, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
